title: Forest fire edge (Firewall)
made_here: The trees are crossed-quad billboards of the Fir Sapling scan rendered from two sides (tools/impostor.py). Ground, firebreak trenches and their cover patches, stakes and tape, charred trunks, ash patches, the stump, the wet burlap sack (with a woven texture made in the build script) and the bucket water are modelled in the build script.
